verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions custom agent workflows and an Agent Flows page, but only as titles or brief mentions. Nothing documents automations that run autonomously in the background, on a recurring schedule, or from event triggers. Automatic meeting transcription is a separate, single-purpose feature, not user-configurable background automation, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
